source.author: verg
source.text: Si non ingentem foribus domus alta superbis mane salutantum totis vomit aedibus undam, nec varios inhiant pulchra testudine postis illusasque auro vestes Ephyreiaque aera, alba neque Assyrio fucatur lana veneno nec casia liquidi corrumpitur usus olivi:
source.text_original: Si non ingentem foribus domus alta superbis / mane salutantum totis vomit aedibus undam, / nec varios inhiant pulchra testudine postis / illusasque auro vestes Ephyreiaque aera, / alba neque Assyrio fucatur lana veneno / nec casia liquidi corrumpitur usus olivi: /
source.text_english: If, at daybreak, the lofty house does not pour forth through its proud doors a great wave of those coming to pay their respects, nor do the doorposts gape for the varied hangings beneath a beautiful coffered ceiling and the glittering robes and Ephyrian bronze, and if the wool is not tinted with Assyrian dye, nor is the use of clear olive oil spoiled with cassia:

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: fores, quae prius salutantum turbas uomebant, nunc a miseris obsidentur.
reuse.text_original: fores, quae prius salutantum turbas uomebant, nunc a miseris obsidentur.
reuse.text_english: the doors, which formerly vomited forth crowds of visitors, are now besieged by the wretched.
